text: Distinguish a service, an interface and a protocol.
choices: Service is what a layer offers upward; interface is how it is requested; protocol is the agreement between peers at the same layer on different machines
Service is hardware, interface is software, protocol is a standard
Protocol is what a layer offers upward
explanation: Services and interfaces run vertically within one machine; protocols run horizontally between machines. Confusing a protocol with an interface is a reliable source of muddle when reading standards.
